topics.label: Energy
facts: Energy is the ability to do work, and it can change from one form to another but is never created or destroyed.
Kinetic energy is the energy of movement, and potential energy is stored energy waiting to be used.
A stretched rubber band has elastic potential energy, and a ball at the top of a hill has gravitational potential energy.
The Sun is Earth's main source of energy, powering weather, plant growth, and the water cycle.

questions.fact: Energy is the ability to make things happen, like moving, heating, or lighting.

questions.q: What happens to energy when it changes form?
choices: It is never created or destroyed, only changed
questions.fact: The law of conservation of energy says energy can change form but the total stays the same.

questions.q: Which of these has kinetic energy?
choices: A book sitting on a shelf
A ball resting on the ground
questions.fact: Kinetic energy is the energy of movement, so a rolling ball has it.

questions.q: Which of these has gravitational potential energy?
choices: A ball at the top of a hill
A ball rolling on flat ground
questions.fact: A ball held high up stores gravitational potential energy, which turns into movement as it rolls down.

topics.label: Electricity
facts: Electricity is the flow of tiny particles called electrons through a material.
A complete circuit is a loop that lets electricity flow from a battery, through a device, and back again.
Conductors, like copper wire, let electricity flow easily, while insulators, like rubber, block it.
A switch opens or closes a circuit: when it is closed, current flows and a bulb can light up.

questions.q: What flows through a wire to make electricity?
questions.fact: Electric current is a flow of electrons through a conductor.

questions.q: What does a circuit need to be for a bulb to light?
choices: Two batteries facing the wrong way
A complete loop from the battery and back
questions.fact: Electricity can only flow in a complete, unbroken loop called a closed circuit.

questions.q: Which material is a good conductor of electricity?
questions.fact: Copper lets electrons flow easily, which is why wires are made of copper.

questions.q: What does a switch do in a circuit?
choices: It opens or closes the circuit
questions.fact: Closing a switch completes the circuit so current can flow; opening it stops the flow.

topics.label: Forces
facts: A force is a push or a pull that can change how something moves.
Friction is a force that slows things down when surfaces rub together.
Air resistance is a force that pushes against things moving through air, like a falling parachute.
Balanced forces keep an object still or moving steadily, while unbalanced forces change its speed or direction.

questions.fact: Forces are pushes and pulls that can speed things up, slow them down, or change their direction.

choices: It slows things down when surfaces rub together
questions.fact: Friction acts against movement, which is why a sliding box eventually stops.

questions.q: What force slows a falling parachute?
questions.fact: Air resistance pushes up against the parachute, slowing its fall.

questions.q: What happens when forces on an object are balanced?
choices: It stays still or keeps moving steadily
questions.fact: Balanced forces cancel out, so there is no change in movement.

topics.label: Renewable Energy
facts: Renewable energy comes from sources that nature replaces, like sunlight, wind, and flowing water.
Solar panels turn sunlight directly into electricity.
Wind turbines use moving air to spin blades and make electricity.
Unlike coal and oil, renewable sources do not run out and do not release carbon dioxide when they make power.

questions.q: Which of these is a renewable energy source?
questions.fact: Sunlight is replaced by nature every day, so it is renewable.
Solar panels convert sunlight into electrical energy.

questions.q: How do wind turbines make electricity?
questions.fact: Wind spins the turbine blades, and a generator turns that motion into electricity.

questions.q: What is one advantage of renewable energy over coal?
choices: It does not run out and releases no carbon dioxide while making power
It needs to be dug from mines
questions.fact: Renewables keep coming from nature and produce power without carbon dioxide emissions.
